name: v2ho UCF101-24 video-mAP linker protocol (plan 08 B0)

selection.rule: tune rank by AP50 then AP50:95; adopt the first whose confirm AP50 >= default + 0.5 with AP20 and AP50:95 not below default

geometry_snap_b2.usage: after MOC linking with the frozen linker, blend each tube box 75 percent toward the highest-IoU same-class dense detection from the model own dense head, then temporally smooth with radius 2
geometry_snap_b2.selection: tune-selected on V2HO-HO0-s17 g24/g25 over match_iou {0.3,0.5} x box_blend {0,0.25,0.5,0.75,1.0} x smooth {0,1,2}
geometry_snap_b2.gate: confirm AP50 >= control + 0.5 with AP20 and AP50:95 not below control; met with +1.24 / +0.03 / +2.38
geometry_snap_b2.parity: box_blend 0.0 reproduces the frozen-B0 control exactly on both partitions
geometry_snap_b2.not_adopted: smooth_radius 1 scored 44.15 strict on confirm but selection is on tune only
